errors.text_span: Дания и Естония показват отрицателни стойности в 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The description states that both Denmark and Estonia have negative values in 2008. According to the chart, only Denmark has a negative value for 2008 (turquoise bar below zero). Estonia has a positive value for 2008 (turquoise bar is above zero, at approximately +25%).
